answer: The ember counter is kept in sable and delta reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An farming party therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Scaling to 762 identities multiplies that fee by 214 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
